# CAD-Recode attribution

Source: https://github.com/filaPro/cad-recode (demo.ipynb).
Authors: Danila Rukhovich, Elona Dupont, Dimitrios Mallis, Kseniya Cherenkova,
Anis Kacem, and Djamila Aouada, University of Luxembourg.
Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.14042 (ICCV 2025).

Upstream source is retained in demo.ipynb; LICENSE.md contains its CC BY-NC 4.0
license. model.py is adapted for CPU/MPS dtype handling, attention masks, and
standalone use without visualization or PyTorch3D. No upstream endorsement.
Checkpoint: filapro/cad-recode-v1.5; tokenizer: Qwen/Qwen2-1.5B.
These upstream assets have their own license terms; this integration does not
relicense them. This is a noncommercial research benchmark.
